text:
maria: quick one — seeing 401s on long-lived streaming connections after we switched to service account impersonation. token looks fine but the SDK isn't refreshing mid-stream. anyone seen this with node/python clients?

sam: which token are you using for the stream? the access token from impersonation or a signed JWT?

maria: impersonation -> short-lived access token (1h). root cause seems to be the aud claim on the JWT we exchange for impersonation. our token's aud is `https://iam.googleapis.com/` but the SDK expects the Redwood audience `https://api.redwood.ai/` when validating for streaming endpoints.

ton y: (typo) tony: ah that mismatch will make the platform reject refresh-exchange if we try to reauth mid-stream. how does the node client do refreshes for streaming sockets?

chloe: node client currently attaches the auth header once at stream start and relies on token auto-refresh only for subsequent new stream attempts. it doesn't inject a new Authorization header into an already-open websocket/HTTP2 stream.

maria: here's a minimal repro of the exchange we do in Python — we build a JWT then exchange to impersonate:```python
now = int(time.time())
payload = {
  "iss": SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL,
  "scope": "https://api.redwood.ai/.default",
  "aud": "https://iam.googleapis.com/",  # <- this was the problem
  "exp": now + 3600,
  "iat": now,
}
signed = sign_jwt(payload)
resp = requests.post("https://sts.googleapis.com/v1/token", data={
  'grant_type': 'urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer',
  'assertion': signed,
})
access_token = resp.json()['access_token']
```

sam: that aud is correct for the GCP STS flow (you post to sts.googleapis.com) but Redwood requires the eventual access token to be valid for our resource/audience. If the token exchange doesn't include the resource/audience param the returned token might not contain the expected audience claim.

tony: practical fixes: 1) include `resource=https://api.redwood.ai/` in the STS token exchange so the resulting access token has the right audience; or 2) for impersonation use `--aud`/`audience` when creating the signed token if your IdP supports it.

chloe: also note SDK workarounds: Node: call `client.getAccessToken()` right before opening the stream and pass the returned token explicitly in the stream init (e.g., `Authorization: Bearer ${token}`) so the stream starts with as-fresh-as-possible token. Python: our python SDK refreshes tokens lazily but a live HTTP/2 stream suffers the same problem if the server forces reauth mid-stream.

maria: tried adding `resource` to STS exchange and that fixed the aud mismatch — streams accept the token. but still ran into the reconnection behavior: when the server returns 401 mid-stream, node doesn't rehandshake/replay the auth, it just bubbles an error.

ton y: we can patch the node streaming layer to treat 401 as a refresh-and-retry trigger: on 401, call the auth provider to get a fresh token, re-open the stream once automatically, and replay the minimal resume payload. cheap fix, low risk.

sam: agree. also add instrumentation: log `auth_refresh_attempt` and `stream_reopen` events so support can see how often it happens.

chloe: I'll sketch a small PR: - update docs with STS `resource` example - node client change: treat 401 as retry-with-refreshed-token (single retry) - add example snippet for explicitly passing token into stream init (both node & python)

maria: thanks — that covers it. one more gotcha I hit: if you set `scope` too narrowly during impersonation (no `/.default`) the returned token won't have the delegated service scopes we need. so recommend `scope: https://api.redwood.ai/.default` or use `delegates` flow for impersonation chains.

chloe: noted. I'll include both examples and a short troubleshooting checklist: aud mismatch, wrong scope, token lifetime too short, and client not reauthing mid-stream.

deploy-bot: reminder: opens a small RFC + PR branch `devex/stream-auth-retry` with CHANGELOG entry.

maria: rough ETA for PR?

chloe: I'll have a docs patch + tests by EOD tomorrow, node client unit test for 401->retry in 48 hours.

maria: perfect — thanks everyone :heart:
